title: Latin Mix USA 2 CD Ricky Martin Jennifer Lopez Marc Anthony Shakira Sony
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Latin Mix USA 2 - Various Artists (Sony Discos / Columbia 69989).

Features Ricky Martin, Elvis Crespo, Chayanne, MDO, Will Smith,
Ivy Queen featuring Wyclef Jean, Shakira, DLG (Dark Latin Groove), Fey,
Jennifer Delgado, Grupo Mania, and Jennifer Lopez in a duet with
Marc Anthony.

A&R supervision and compilation by Sony Discos and Joanna Uribe.
Mastered by Joseph M. Palmaccio at Sony Music Studios, NYC.
See the photographed back insert for the full track listing.

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
